name: io.github.nicolaskheirallah/polestar-mcp
description: Read-only Polestar Data Portal (M2M) telemetry and charging for MCP clients.

environmentVariables.name: POLESTAR_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Data Portal M2M OAuth client id.

environmentVariables.name: POLESTAR_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Data Portal M2M OAuth client secret.

environmentVariables.name: POLESTAR_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Account ID sent as x-client-id. Not the OAuth client id: the gateway returns 403 AUTHZ_CLIENT_ID_MISMATCH for that.

environmentVariables.name: POLESTAR_ALLOW_LOCATION
environmentVariables.description: Set false to never request or return vehicle position.

environmentVariables.name: POLESTAR_FIXTURES_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Offline mode against captured responses; no credentials needed.
